verses.text: I love the LORD because he hears my voice when I cry for mercy.
He leaned in to listen to me, so I’ll call on him as long as I live.
Death’s ropes wrapped around me. The pains of Sheol grabbed hold of me. I found myself in trouble and grief.
Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, please save my life!”
The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is full of mercy.
The LORD watches over the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.
You can rest again, my soul. The LORD has been so good to you.
You saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling.
I’ll walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
I believed, so I said, “I’ve been through serious trouble.”
I spoke in a rush and said, “Everybody lies.”
What can I give the LORD for all the good he’s done for me?
I’ll lift up the cup of salvation and call on the LORD’s name.
I’ll keep my vows to the LORD, right there in front of all his people.
The death of the people set apart for him is precious in the LORD’s eyes.
LORD, I really am your servant. I’m your servant, the son of your servant girl. You’ve set me free from my chains.
I’ll bring you a sacrifice of thanks and call on the LORD’s name.
I’ll keep my vows to the LORD in front of all his people,
in the courtyards of the LORD’s house, right in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
